eslint.command: npx eslint --format json (frontend/, default project scope, npm-ci-locked version)

policy.description: The ratchet requires current == baseline for every governed metric. current > baseline is a REGRESSION (fails: new debt was introduced). current < baseline is STALE (fails: real debt was reduced but this file was not ratcheted down — update the counts below in the same PR that reduced them). Baseline increases are prohibited except through an explicit, documented governance decision; baseline decreases are a routine required edit, not a governance decision.
